title: Gatto settings

version.description: Settings format version, independent of the application release version.

owner.description: GitHub account or organization. Changing it clears repository pins; projects retain selections scoped to their saved owner.

pinned_repositories.description: Repository picker favorites for the configured owner. They do not select the Add from Clipboard destination.

upload_action.description: Globally remembered action for the upload menu. Upload and copy copies successful attachments from the new batch.

add_from_clipboard_project.description: Project folder used for Add from Clipboard. Null uses Scratchpad. Repository selection is not required to save a draft.

pinned_projects.description: Project folders kept above unpinned projects. The Add from Clipboard project always comes first.

automatically_copy_add_from_clipboard.description: Allow Add from Clipboard to upload the saved clipboard item to GitHub and copy the resulting output automatically. Disabled by default; manual upload is available from the notification.

description: Per-user application preferences. Repository selections belong only in project manifests. Omitted preferences use application defaults; unversioned legacy settings are migrated when loaded.

projectFolder.description: One direct folder name inside ~/.gatto/projects; never an absolute or relative path.
